summary: Iteration 38 - Stripe → Premium Flow. All features tested and working: POST /api/payments/checkout creates real Stripe checkout URL, GET /api/payments/checkout/status/{id} returns payment status, GET /api/payments/packages returns 3 packages (standard:€997, accelerator:€4997, enterprise:€2497), GET /api/payments/history returns transactions. Premium activation correctly sets user.premium=true, credits.balance=-1, is_premium=true. Premium users can chat unlimited (no 402). Free users with 0 credits get 402 'no_credits'. PaymentSuccessPage shows checking state with green neon spinner, then error state after polling fails.
